# Hub

The map of content. Every link form this server claims to understand appears
below exactly once.

## Notes

- Bare name: [[Chimera]]
- Aliased display text: [[Chimera|the programme]]
- Heading anchor: [[Chimera#Goals]]
- Block reference: [[Chimera#^decision-1]]
- Path style: [[Projects/Meeting Notes]]
- Ambiguous bare name: [[Meeting Notes]]
- Through a frontmatter alias: [[Chimera Programme]]
- Through an alias with different case: [[prd-7]]
- Filename with different case: [[chimera]]
- Markdown link: [the old plan](Archive/2019/Old Plan.md)
- Markdown link with an anchor: [the goals](Projects/Chimera.md#Goals)
- Dangling: [[Nowhere In Particular]]

## Embeds

- A whole note: ![[Chimera]]
- A section of a note: ![[Chimera#Goals]]
- An image: ![[Assets/diagram.png]]
- A document: [[Assets/spec.pdf]]
- A canvas: [[Board.canvas]]

## Hidden

%%
Everything in this block is a comment. Obsidian does not render it, so none of
it is part of what this note says: not [[Chimera]], not [[A Ghost Note]], and
not #hiddentag.
%%

An inline %%[[Also Hidden]] #alsohidden%% aside, mid-sentence.

## Not links

```markdown
[[Not A Link]] and ![[Not An Embed]] and [not one](Nope.md) and #notatag
```

Inline code: `[[Also Not A Link]]` and `#notatagineither`.
